{
  "name": "pixel-parade",
  "displayName": "Pixel Parade",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Hand-drawn pixel-art cats and dogs wander above the prompt: they stroll, sit, nap, zoom, share hearts and chase each other. Choose how many, and cats, dogs or both.",
  "author": {
    "name": "VkaZas",
    "url": "https://github.com/VkaZas"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/VkaZas/claude-code-mods/tree/main/pixel-parade",
  "repository": "https://github.com/VkaZas/claude-code-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "fun",
    "pets",
    "pixel-art",
    "cats",
    "dogs"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "count": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Count / 数量",
      "description": "How many animals wander above the prompt at once / 同时走动的数量",
      "options": [
        "1",
        "2",
        "3",
        "4",
        "5",
        "6",
        "8"
      ],
      "default": "3"
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Animals / 种类",
      "description": "both: cats and dogs; cats: cats only; dogs: dogs only",
      "options": [
        "both",
        "cats",
        "dogs"
      ],
      "default": "both"
    },
    "style": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Style / 样式",
      "description": "pixel: hand-drawn pixel art; ascii: =^.^= characters",
      "options": [
        "pixel",
        "ascii"
      ],
      "default": "pixel"
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language / 语言",
      "description": "en: English; zh: 中文",
      "options": [
        "en",
        "zh"
      ],
      "default": "en"
    }
  }
}
